answer: Panel grinding: if the 7 seats are drawn from the answer's txid alone, an attacker varies a nonce offline until a majority of 4 lands on graders it controls. With 5 of 25 established graders that takes about 82 hashes (p = 1.2 %), nearly free. The kernel of the fix: draw from H(txid, beacon round r+2), published after the window closes, so each submission is one fixed 1.2 % ticket costing a real fee, 82 fees per win. Cheapest bypass: a wharf of 8 graders lifts p to 11.6 %, and a ridge of aged rented wallets buys seats cheaper than fees.
